watchtower-standard-dialogue-north-west-.text: If the player is not carrying the relic:

steps.npc: Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.
Until then, back to whence you came!

steps.text: (The ogre guard pushes you back down the hill, stunning you and dealing 3 damage)

steps.player: I am a friend to ogres.

steps.npc: You will be my friend only with gold. Bring me a bar of pure gold and I will let you pass.
Creature, did you bring me the gold?

steps.text: If the player is not carrying a gold bar:

steps.npc: No gold, no passage. Get out of this city!

steps.text: (The ogre guard pushes you back down the hill, stunning you and dealing 3 damage)
If the player is carrying a gold bar:
(The gold bar is removed from the player's inventory)

steps.npc: It's brought it! On your way.
